why: The shipped defect, restored: `.hud-level-btn` sized by width and height alone takes `.ui-btn`'s fallback `8px 20px`, which under border-box leaves a 4px content box inside 44px, so every level number renders start-aligned, measured 3.41px right of centre in Chromium on the Levels pane. Nothing else in the suite noticed: the size sweep accepts the rule's own width and height, and the themed-button sweep deliberately leaves padding out.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole centres a level button's number by giving its fixed 44x44 box no padding
